name: PLAIN Basics
description: Common PLAIN (.plain) code templates and patterns

snippets.name: Comment
snippets.description: Line comment, usable inline
snippets.content:
rem: This is a comment
var count = 10    rem: inline comment

snippets.name: Multi-line Comment
snippets.description: Indentation-scoped block comment
snippets.content:
note:
    This comment spans
    multiple lines.

snippets.name: Variable Assignment
snippets.description: Declare a variable, then reassign it
snippets.content:
var strName = "World"
strName = "Everyone"

snippets.name: Typed Variable
snippets.description: Explicit type annotation on declaration
snippets.content:
var count as integer = 0
var price as float = 9.99

snippets.name: Constant
snippets.description: Declare an immutable, fixed value
snippets.content: fxd MAX_COUNT as int = 10

snippets.name: Display
snippets.description: Print a value, string interpolation with v"..."
snippets.content:
display("Hello, " & strName & "!")
display(v"Hello, {strName}!")

snippets.name: Get Input
snippets.description: Prompt and read a value, converting type as needed
snippets.content:
var strName = get("What is your name? ")
var intAge = to_int(get("How old are you? "))

snippets.name: If/Else
snippets.description: Binary conditional (nest ifs in else for elseif behavior)
snippets.content:
if intTemperature > 80
    display("It's hot outside!")
else
    display("The weather is pleasant.")

snippets.name: Choose/Choice
snippets.description: Multi-way branching on a value
snippets.content:
choose strDay
    choice "Monday"
        display("Start of the work week!")
    choice "Friday"
        display("Almost the weekend!")
    default
        display("Just a regular day.")

snippets.name: Counting Loop
snippets.description: Loop a variable from a start to an end value, with optional step
snippets.content:
loop i from 1 to 5
    display("Count: " & i)

loop i from 10 to 1 step -1
    display(i & "...")

snippets.name: For-each Loop
snippets.description: Iterate over a list
snippets.content:
loop fruit in fruits
    display("I like " & fruit & "!")

snippets.name: While-style Loop
snippets.description: Condition-only loop
snippets.content:
loop count < 5
    display(count)
    count = count + 1

snippets.name: Infinite Loop
snippets.description: Bare loop with an explicit exit
snippets.content:
loop
    work()
    if done
        exit

snippets.name: Task (Function)
snippets.description: A task that computes and delivers a value
snippets.content:
task Add using (a, b)
    deliver a + b

snippets.name: Task (Procedure)
snippets.description: A task with side effects and no return value
snippets.content:
task Greet with (name)
    display("Greetings, " & name & "!")

snippets.name: Task (No Args)
snippets.description: A task with no parameters and no return value
snippets.content:
task Main()
    display("Hello, World!")

snippets.name: List
snippets.description: Create, index, and mutate a list
snippets.content:
var lstColors = ["red", "green", "blue"]
display("First color: " & lstColors[0])
append(lstColors, "yellow")

snippets.name: Table
snippets.description: Create a table (dictionary) and access values

snippets.name: Record
snippets.description: Define and instantiate a custom record type
snippets.content:
record Student:
    name as string
    age as integer = 18
    grade as string = "A"

var student1 = Student(name: "Alice", age: 20, grade: "A")

snippets.name: String Concatenation
snippets.description: Join strings with & and use interpolation
snippets.content:
var greeting = "Hello" & " " & "World"
var msg = v"Hello {name}, you are {age} years old"

snippets.name: Attempt/Handle/Ensure
snippets.description: Try a block, handle an error, and always run cleanup
snippets.content:
attempt
    display("Working...")
    abort "Something went wrong"
handle err as string
    display("Error was caught: " & err)
ensure
    display("Cleanup complete.")

snippets.name: Import Modules
snippets.description: Import modules and tasks with a use: block
snippets.content:
use:
    modules:
        utils
        io.files

snippets.name: Swap
snippets.description: Swap the values of two variables
snippets.content: swap a, b

snippets.name: Operators Reference
snippets.description: Arithmetic, string, comparison, and logical operators
snippets.content:
rem: Arithmetic: + - * / // % **
rem: String:     & (concatenation)
rem: Comparison: == != < > <= >=
rem: Logical:    and or not
